tasks.title: Implement WorkflowRegistry with mandatory-control conformance enforcement
tasks.description: Create src/runtime/registry.ts. Loads workflow specs (piorx-shipped only in Phase 1), registers Stage implementations against stage ids declared in the spec, validates referential integrity at boot (every stage has an implementation; every input/output is a known artifact type; every gate id is registered). Enforces extension conformance: extensions cannot remove or weaken mandatory_controls; cannot register a stage id that overlaps an existing stage with weaker access policy; nested sub-workflow operating_mode must be <= parent's; mandatory_controls propagate downward additively only; cycles rejected; max nesting depth (default 3) registry-configurable. Platform policy prevails over workflow configuration on conflict.
tasks.deliverable: WorkflowRegistry singleton with boot-time validation and conformance enforcement
acceptance_criteria: Boot-time validation fails loudly when a Stage's input/output disagrees with the workflow spec
An extension that removes or weakens a mandatory_controls gate is rejected at boot
Sub-workflow conformance rules (operating_mode <= parent, additive mandatory_controls, no cycles, depth cap) are enforced at boot

tasks.title: Author default piorx workflow spec as markdown with YAML frontmatter
tasks.description: Hand-author src/runtime/workflows/piorx-default.workflow.md as a piorx/workflow-spec@1 artifact. YAML frontmatter declares shape (kind, id, name, description, operating_mode: supervised-change, mandatory_controls: [intent.approval, execution.allow_edits], goals, stages with model_class and gates, edges with structured when and natural-language description, governance sub-block, recursive_promotion_target: restatement). Markdown body expands each YAML field in plain English; conventional sections are ## Operating mode, ## Goals, ## Stages (one H3 per stage matching stages[].id), optional ## Edges and ## Governance. The natural-language fields are load-bearing for agent-readability.
tasks.deliverable: Default piorx workflow as a schema-validated markdown spec, source of truth for workflow shape and intent
acceptance_criteria: Spec validates as piorx/workflow-spec@1 at boot
Six default stages (restatement, expansion, retrieval, evidence, synthesis, execution) declared with correct artifact-type inputs and outputs
operating_mode and mandatory_controls match the supervised-change defaults
Markdown body explains stage purpose, gate rationale, and goal meaning at a level an agent can act on without reading TS source
